# /proc mounted with hidepid=invisible: other users' processes do not exist for us.
# alice's shell was started by root's sshd-session, which is invisible (ppid 590 missing).
hidepid invisible
self 610
user 1000 alice

proc pid=610 ppid=590 comm=zsh tty=pts/2
proc pid=611 ppid=610 comm=sleep tty=pts/2 pgrp=611

expect check tty=pts:2 start=610 euid=1000 => start personal hidepid
expect check tty=pts:2 start=610 euid=1000 fallback=skip => skip hidepid
expect holder pts=2 start=610 => none
